comments.text:
It’s basically been a domino effect. Airbnb started going downhill after they went public. They raised their fees to keep investors happy, and a lot of hosts passed those costs on to guests with higher prices and cleaning fees.

Then, during the housing frenzy, a lot of people bought Airbnb properties way over asking price. Now they have expensive mortgages, so they have to charge more just to make the numbers work. Other hosts saw those higher prices and raised theirs too.

Now the market is way oversaturated, prices are ridiculous, and Airbnb just isn’t the deal it used to be.
